therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD20-targeted antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity combined with BTK kinase inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Enhanced B-cell depletion and inhibition of B-cell receptor signaling in CLL cells
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Previously treated high-risk chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients

safety_signals: Cardiac events more frequent in combination arm
results.dose_information: Ublituximab administered as IV infusion, Ibrutinib administered orally
